sloka: राजर्षिणा गुणवता महर्षि सम तेजसा ।मत् तुल्य तपसा चैव क्षत्र धर्म स्थितेन च ॥१-४४-१०॥
transliteration: rājarṣiṇā guṇavatā maharṣi sama tejasā ।mat tulya tapasā caiva kṣatra dharma sthitena ca ॥1-44-10॥

translations.english: O Sinless one (Bhagiratha) O Distinguished one on the part of Dilipa brilliant your father who had the virtuous of a rajarshi, who was equal to a maharshi in splendour, and to me in austerities and abiding to the duties of a kshatriya it was even not possible to bring Ganga through prayer.
